column7: 2026-11-05: Plan (user's): sort_keys option gets added on main first (for upstream), then brought over to this acme branch. On THIS branch sort_keys must default to ON, because Acme's tooling calls plain dumps() and their call sites can't be changed. Reason: key-order churn between drops comes from how our side builds dicts, and Acme reviewers diff configs. Main/upstream default is the user's call, not decided here.

2026-11-05: sort_keys (keyword-only, default off) is committed on main as 02fc482. Next: bring it to the acme branch with the default ON, per the user's plan; don't edit Acme's call sites. README and CHANGELOG entries were skipped on purpose (my choice; changelog has no unreleased section).

2026-11-05: sort_keys brought over from main (cherry-pick of 02fc482) and default flipped to True in dump/dumps/Context. Five existing order-dependent tests (test_style x4, test_types::test_decimal) were pinned to sort_keys=False by me, rather than changing expected output. When syncing with main, keep these differences.
